annotations.title: Resolve a model name or suggest matches

description: Read-only. Resolve user shorthand such as Seedream 5.0, Nano Banana 2 or Seedance 2 Mini against enabled models. Case, punctuation and trailing .0 are normalized. Unique matches return canonical IDs; ambiguous names and typos return suggestions for clarification. Never silently substitute a different version or default. No credits spent.

kind.description: Model family to resolve: image, video or audio.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

query.description: Model name, shorthand or spelling supplied by the user to resolve to a canonical model ID.

name: playground_model_resolve

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
